name: 41. Jõulumäe Metsajooks
description:
The Jõulumäe Forest Run takes place on the third Sunday of November, 15 November, bringing running enthusiasts from Pärnu County and beyond together for the 41st time in the scenic Jõulumäe dune pine forest. It is one of Jõulumäe’s oldest and most beloved races. Come celebrate this sporting tradition with us—it’s a day when the entire pine forest fills with happy participants, supporters cheering on the runners, and autumn colours.

The Forest Run is open to everyone who enjoys being active. In addition to the traditional 9 km main race, the programme includes shorter races for children (500 m, 1,000 m and 2,000 m). This year, jogging has been added alongside recreational walking. No times are recorded for these 5.6 km distances; participants can enjoy the activity for themselves.

Runners compete in 18 age categories. Early registration is open until 12.11.2026 at 23:59.

Recommendations:

To avoid unnecessary rushing on site, early registration is strongly recommended.
By registering early, you help ensure the event is better organised—we know to expect you and can plan accordingly. You’ll also have more time to get ready on site.
If registering on site, please arrive promptly and adhere to the registration schedule.

name: TreeningPluss Vääna jõesuu jooks-matk
location: Vääna-Jõesuu, Harku Parish, Harju County, Estonia

name: TreeningPluss Muraste jooks-matk
location: Muraste, Harku Parish, Harju County, Estonia

name: 2026 Audi Vana-aasta jooksupäev
location: Rocca al Mare kool, Tallinn, Harju County, Estonia
description: Audi Vana-aasta jooksupäev is a traditional winter running event taking place on 19 December 2026 in front of Rocca al Mare School in Tallinn. The event centre and start/finish are conveniently located at the school, and the programme includes three distances: a marathon, a relay marathon and an 8.4 km run. The courses run mainly along shared-use paths and are well marked and safe, offering a sporting way to end the year. Participants are provided with medical assistance, timing, medals, and hot tea at the refreshment stations and finish.
course_highlights: The 8.4 km run follows shared-use paths and is marked with signs and course marshals.
The marathon consists of 5 laps, each a 8.44 km paved shared-use path.
The relay marathon consists of 5 legs, each a lap of 8.44 km.
additional: The marathon and relay marathon have participant limits of 100 marathon runners and 150 teams, respectively. The 8.4 km run is limited to 150 runners. Race numbers are distributed on race day at Rocca al Mare School. Medical assistance is available at the start/finish area. Awards are presented after the run or marathon, as applicable. Running on the road is prohibited and may result in disqualification. The course is in an urban setting. Registration and entry fees are listed in detail. The event is held annually and is part of the Estonian running calendar.

name: Winter Run 2027
description: Winter Run 2027 is a seaside winter run in Narva-Jõesuu, held as part of Estonia Winter Fest. The programme includes a 300 m children’s run and 3.5 km and 7 km distances. The main distances are electronically timed, and every finisher receives a medal. After the run, participants can visit the festival sauna village and attend the main concert free of charge by presenting their bib number.

name: ÜLEMISTE Grit 2027
organizer: Eesti Ööjooks - Night Run Estonia ja Liikumisharrastuse kompetentsikeskus

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Virtuaalne osalemine: 24€ (sisaldab medalit, tulemuse haldamise tasu ja saatmiskulu)

description: Ülemiste Grit is an immersive endurance running event held inside Ülemiste Centre in Tallinn. Participants can choose a 1-, 2- or 3-hour challenge, running a 552-metre loop. The event is not a race, but an opportunity to enjoy moving and challenge yourself: you can run, walk or power-walk. There is an aid station on the course offering water, juice and solid food, and a medal and gift bag await at the finish. The event has a limited number of participants and offers a unique indoor running experience.
course_highlights: The course runs on the second floor of Ülemiste Centre; each loop is 552 m long.
The indoor course has tiled floors and extensive glass surfaces, so take care.
The aid station offers water, juice, Coca-Cola and solid food (banana, pickles, bread, meat product, chocolate and orange).
additional: Race pack collection takes place from 19:00 to 21:30 on the third floor of the Ülemiste Centre parking garage. Bag storage at the event centre costs €2. Medals and gift bags are handed out at the event centre after finishing. After finishing, participants are asked to stay in the finish area briefly for a group photo. Participants in the 2-hour distance are asked to enter the start area via the first floor (take the escalator near Rimi). The event is sold out; on-site registration is not available. The virtual run option ends on 22.04.2027. Participants can leave their own drinks bottles along the course, labelled with their names. The event is non-competitive and emphasises cooperation and safety. Participants receive gift bags; the course is designed to be an experience, not for chasing records.

name: Sportland Kõrvemaa Kevadjooks 2027
location: Sportland Kõrvemaa Matka- ja Suusakeskus, Kõrvemaa, Estonia
description: Sportland Kõrvemaa Spring Run is a beautiful spring running event held amid the ancient natural landscapes of the Kõrvemaa Nature Reserve. The event centre is conveniently located near Tallinn at the Sportland Kõrvemaa Hiking and Ski Centre. The varied routes include a 16 km main distance, a 6 km run and a youth run. Free children’s runs, activities for the whole family and childcare are also available. After the run, participants can enjoy hot soup, a sauna and hot tubs, as well as an exciting treasure hunt at Anija Manor.
course_highlights: The entire route runs through a nature reserve
A range of distances: 16 km, 6 km and a youth run
Event centre conveniently located near Tallinn
additional: Free bus transport is provided for participants between Aegviidu railway station and the event centre, in both directions. The event centre has childcare, a bag drop, a Stebby wellbeing area with Fysiotikker, and a Sportland pop-up shop where you can top up on running gear. For children, Aegviidu RMK offers nature-themed activities, a low ropes course, a mini-pancake café, and horse and pony rides (bring cash). A sauna and hot tubs will be open after the run. Participants can enter a draw to win a stylish Trek city bike at the Spring Run awards ceremony at 14:00. Group discounts: 10% off when registering at least 5 participants, and 20% off when registering at least 10 participants. A 50% discount is available for seniors (60+) and young people (up to 17) when registering in advance; the minimum final price is €15. The event takes place on 25 April 2027, offering a choice of distances and the chance to enjoy outdoor exercise and time with family.

name: 45. Tartu Maastikumaraton
description: The 45th Tartu Forest Marathon is a traditional event held at the Tartumaa Sports Centre, offering participants the chance to enjoy trail running in beautiful natural surroundings. The event is part of Estonia’s programme to promote recreational physical activity and is suitable for runners of different abilities who want to improve their fitness and mental well-being. The marathon highlights the importance of physical activity for maintaining health and well-being and invites everyone who leads an active lifestyle to take part. It is organised by the Centre of Excellence for Physical Activity, which supports the development of a healthier and more active society in Estonia.
course_highlights: Trail running through the beautiful forest landscapes of the Tartumaa Sports Centre
A varied and changing course suitable for runners of different abilities
An opportunity to enjoy nature and improve mental and physical health
additional: The event takes place at the Tartumaa Sports Centre. Participants can register and collect their race numbers at Turu 10 in Tartu and in the car park at Aura Centre.

name: 3. Benno Viirandi nimeline rahvajooks
description: The 3rd Benno Viirand Memorial Fun Run is a family-oriented running and Nordic walking event held in Mustla. The race follows a 5 km course, starting near the Vambola bus stop in Soe village and finishing at the Tarvastu Gymnasium stadium. The event aims to honour the memory of the legendary runner Benno Viirand and promote running as a healthy way to spend time. In addition to the main race, free children’s races are held at the stadium. Participants are provided with race numbers and can register in advance or in person on race day.

name: Arco Vara 55. jooks ümber Harku järve
description: The 55th Arco Vara Run Around Lake Harku is a traditional 6.5 km running race taking place on 30 May 2026 at Lake Harku beach. The race is part of the 2026 Maru Lake Runs series and is its second event. There are refreshment points along the course, which is marked and secured by a course marshal team. In addition to runners, Nordic walkers and walkers are also welcome; they start in the last group. The event centre is at the start/finish area, where race numbers are also issued and awards presented.

name: Koeru kergejõustikuvõistlused
description: Koeru Athletics Competition is a traditional track and field event held at the Koeru Secondary School stadium. Men and women compete in two age groups and take part in several events, including the 100 m run, long jump, shot put, discus throw, javelin throw, and 1000 m run. The winner is determined by adding the points from their three best events. The competition is open to everyone, and participants may enter all events. Young athletes use throwing implements appropriate for their age group.

name: Maardu kevadjooks
description: Maardu Spring Run and Health Walk is a traditional sports day held in Maardu, bringing together people of all ages who enjoy being active. The event features several runs and health walks for different age groups and abilities, including children’s runs, a youth run, a walk for people with special needs, and 3 km and 5 km runs. Participation is free, and every finisher receives a medal. The event aims to offer the joy of movement, a sense of well-being, and an active day outdoors, while highlighting time spent together with family and friends.

name: Läänemaa sörgib ühissörk
description: Läänemaa Jog Together is a fun, relaxed family event taking place on 31 May at Haapsalu Railway Station. The group jog is about 3+ kilometres at an easy pace (~7:30 min/km), welcoming everyone in Läänemaa who enjoys being active. The event is the campaign’s grand finale, bringing together the various jogs held across the county during May. Both previous participants and newcomers are welcome to enjoy being active together and strengthen the sense of community.

name: Meie oma maijooks 2026
description: Our own Maijooks 2026 is a traditional running event held on 1 June at the Kolga-Jaani School stadium and sports fields. The event offers various distances and age categories suitable for runners, Nordic walkers and recreational athletes of all ages. Its aim is to promote a healthy lifestyle, provide an opportunity to compete and celebrate family-friendly activities in the Kolga-Jaani area. Participants can enjoy a pleasant evening run on the light-traffic path and at the stadium, with recognition for the top runners and representatives of the area.

name: Virtuaaljooks suvi 2026
description: Virtual Run Summer 2026 is a flexible, remote running event that allows participants to complete their chosen distance in their local area at a time that suits them. The event offers several distance options, including 5 km, 10 km and a half marathon (21 km), as well as the option to take part in a children’s race. Participants can record and upload their results to the GoAndRun.eu portal, ensuring that results are reliable and can be compared with those of other participants around the world. The virtual run offers a convenient, environmentally friendly way to take part in sport without having to travel to an event venue.

name: Kambja Tervisejooksud
description: Kambja Health Runs is a traditional running series event that began in 2016 and will take place in three stages in 2026. The runs are held on the Kambja health trails, giving participants the opportunity to enjoy forest paths and some asphalt sections. The series aims to promote healthy lifestyles and motivate people to take up recreational running. Each stage features a 10 km race, as well as a health run and a power run, which uses body weight and elevation gain in its calculations. Runners who participate in all three stages will receive a series T-shirt, and the grand prize winners will receive a Merida Big Nine 20 bicycle.

name: 5. ETAPP - Merimets
description: Stage 5 – Merimetsa is part of the 24th Tervisejooks ja -kõnd series, which takes place in the car parks at Pelguranna and Stroomi Beach. This 3.6 km stage gives participants the chance to enjoy beautiful nature and fitness trails in a coastal area. The event is suitable for both runners and walkers who want to spend time actively and improve their health. The series stages take place in different parts of Tallinn, offering varied landscapes and views.

name: Valgamaa lahtised MV
description: The Valgamaa Open Championships in Orienteering Sprint is an orienteering competition held in the Valga area. The competition is part of the RMK Eestimaa Orienteerumispäevakud, family events with no age restrictions. The courses are designed for participants of different skill levels, and competitors can choose a pace that suits them. Timing is used at the competition, and an SI card can be rented if needed to help with orienteering. The event is for everyone who wants to enjoy outdoor activity and orienteering in good company.

name: Lammasmäe Eesti Ööjooks - Rakvere 2026
description: LAMMASMÄE Estonian Night Run - Rakvere 2026 is a night running race taking place in Rakvere on June 12, 2026. This popular sporting event brings together running enthusiasts and offers an exciting, lively night-running experience. The race takes place amid the beautiful scenery around Rakvere, giving participants a unique opportunity to enjoy sport and the urban environment at night.
course_highlights: Night run in Rakvere and its surroundings
Beautiful and varied terrain
Lively and energetic race atmosphere
additional: The event includes a range of distance options and promotes healthy lifestyles and community support.

name: Jaanikese jooksukross
description: The Jaanikese running cross-country race is the second event in the series and takes place at the Jaanikese Motor and Leisure Centre. The course features varied terrain suitable for both recreational and experienced runners. The event offers the chance to enjoy a sporting competition in beautiful natural surroundings and is part of the centre’s active running and cycling trail.

name: Narva Linna Jooks - 5 km ja 21,1 km
description: The Narva City Run is the largest mass-participation sports event in Ida-Viru County, taking place on June 5 and 6 at Joaorg in Narva. The two-day event features a mile run around Town Hall Square on Friday, followed by the main races on Saturday, including the 5 km and 21.1 km distances. This year’s course is flatter, allowing runners to achieve better times, and the event also hosts the Estonian Road Mile Championships. The Narva City Run brings thousands of recreational runners and elite athletes to the course, offering a great mass-participation sports experience.

name: Luhamaa piirijooks
description: Luhamaa Border Run is part of the Võrumaa running and walking series, offering a variety of distances for both runners and walkers. The main distance follows paved roads around the Luhamaa village hall and is approximately 5.9 km long. There are also shorter mini-distances and races for toddlers, suitable for participants of all ages. The series aims to provide a sporting and friendly race experience amid Võrumaa’s beautiful natural surroundings.

name: Padise liigub
description: Padise liigub is part of the Lääne-Harju movement series and takes place at the Padise community centre of the Lääne-Harju Cultural Centre. The route passes through Padise’s beautiful landscape, offering excitement and scenic views for runners, walkers and Nordic walkers. The event is suitable for the whole family, with children’s races in addition to the main 5 km distance. It is a wonderful opportunity to enjoy being active in a historic and naturally beautiful setting.

name: Jaanikese jooksukross
description: The 2nd Jaanikese Cross-Country Run takes place on 6 June 2026 at the Jaanikese Moto and Leisure Centre and is part of the Rein Leppik Valgamaa Running and Walking Series. The event offers several distances, including children’s races, a 2.7 km run and walk, and the main 5.4 km run. The routes follow the motocross track, giving participants the chance to enjoy a sporting competition across different age groups. The organiser, Valgamaa Sports Association, welcomes all running enthusiasts to take part and enjoy an active day.

name: SunRun
description: SunRun Saaremaa 2026 is a team running experience held amid Saaremaa’s beautiful natural scenery. The run starts at sunrise in Kuressaare and finishes at sunset at Illiku laid in Orissaare, covering a total of 180 km. Any group, circle of friends, or sports club can take part by forming a team and dividing the distance among its members. The aim is not to win, but to run together with friends at a comfortable pace and enjoy the experience. Each participant receives a GPS wristband that serves as a baton, and there are refreshment and food stations along the course.

name: Lääne-Virumaa jooksusari 2026 - 24. Laekvere – Simuna jooks
description: The third stage of the 2026 Lääne-Virumaa running and walking series is the traditional Simuna–Laekvere Run, which has earned a firm place in runners’ calendars and hearts. The run is distinctive because its direction changes every year. The event takes place at Simuna School and welcomes all running enthusiasts.

name: E-Lux Peetri Jooks
description: E-LUX Peetri Run is one of Estonia’s liveliest mass-participation sporting events, bringing together running enthusiasts of different ages and abilities. The main distance is 10 km, which is timed, with prizes awarded to the top finishers. There is also a charity run, a youth run and children’s races. The event takes place in Peetri and, alongside the running, features a large expo and market area with a variety of vendors and entertainment. The charity run supports the Children’s Foundation of Tartu University Hospital and, through it, children with mobility impairments. All finishers receive a cool summer medal.

name: Simuna-Laekvere rahvajooks
description: The Simuna-Laekvere People’s Run is a traditional recreational running event held every other year, alternating between Simuna and Laekvere. The course follows paved roads, with rolling sections and a few climbs, offering participants a varied running experience. The event is friendly and well organized, suitable for both experienced runners and recreational participants, and also offers a sauna and hot soup after the run. The number of participants is usually around 100, creating a pleasant, relaxed atmosphere. Age-group prizes are awarded, and the first ten finishers receive a running shirt.

name: Võru kergejõustikuõhtu
description: The Võru Athletics Evenings series is a traditional series of athletics events combining track races, throwing events and jumps. Each evening features one throwing event, one jumping event and running distances, offering a varied athletics experience. Competitions take place at Võru Stadium, and the IAAF scoring tables are used to determine the rankings. The series has five stages, one of which is the Võru County Championships. Participants must register separately for each stage, and their race bib is valid for the entire season.

name: Lääne-Virumaa noorte MV
description: The Lääne-Virumaa Youth Championships is an athletics competition for young people and adults, held in Rakvere. The events include several athletics disciplines, such as running, jumping and throwing, and are intended for different age groups from U-14 through to adults. The competition aims to honor the memory of Eerik Konist and promote athletics among young people. All age groups receive medals, and the top performers receive special prizes. The competition takes place at the stadium and starts at 11:00; registration opens at 10:00.

name: 6. ETAPP - Nõmme terviserada
description: The Nõmme health trail is part of the Tradehouse health running and walking series organized by Stamina Sports Club, which encourages people to stay active by collecting health kilometres. This stage offers a chance to enjoy the Nõmme area health trail, which is suitable for both runners and walkers. As part of the series, participants can collect health kilometres at both in-person and remote stages, as well as through personal training. The event is open to everyone interested in physical activity who wants to improve their health and spend time actively.

name: Liikumissari" 8.Järvamaa järvede jooksud" V etapp Paide tehisjärve jooks
location: Paide tehisjärv, Paide, Järva County, Estonia

name: 31. Joosu Järvejooksu sarja 3. etapp
location: Viljandi järve tervise- ja suusarada, Viljandi, Estonia
description: The 3rd stage of the Joosu Lake Run Series is a running event held on the health and ski trail around Lake Viljandi. The race gives participants the chance to enjoy beautiful views of the lake and varied terrain. The event is part of a series organised by the Joosu Health Sports Club, which promotes an active and healthy lifestyle. Everyone is welcome to enjoy the sporting atmosphere and the beauty of nature.
course_highlights: Health and ski trail around Lake Viljandi
Beautiful lake views throughout the course
Varied terrain suitable for runners of different levels

name: Vanglateenistuse jooks
description: The Prison Service Run is part of the Ida-Viru Running Series and takes place at the Jõhvi music square. This athletics event gives participants the opportunity to enjoy a run in the beautiful surroundings of Ida-Viru County. The series includes several stages in different locations, offering a varied running experience. The event is open to all running enthusiasts and is traditionally well organized and friendly.

name: ELVA SÜDAÖÖJOOKS 2026 TARTUMAA LIIGUB ETAPP
description: Elva Midnight Run 2026 is a nighttime running and walking event held near the Elva Cultural Centre. The races start in the evening and offer several distance options, including a 10 km run and walk, as well as children’s races. The event is part of Tartu County’s exercise events and is suitable for both active runners and families. The organizers welcome everyone to take part and enjoy a sporty evening in Elva’s beautiful natural surroundings.

name: Eesti noorte KV
description: The Estonian Youth Archery Cup takes place in Pärnu, giving young athletes the opportunity to compete and develop their skills. Several archery clubs from across Estonia take part, making it an important event on the calendar for young archers. The competition is held at Tammiste Stadium, where athletes can demonstrate their accuracy and skill. The event is a tradition and supports the development of young people in archery.

name: EKVA lahtised kergej. võistl.
description: The EKVA Open Athletics Competitions take place in Kohila and offer veterans and recreational athletes the opportunity to compete in a variety of track and field events. The competitions are intended for active athletes of all ages who want to test themselves and enjoy the thrill of athletics. EKVA regularly organizes various championships and series that promote running and athletics in Estonia. The competitions are open to both recreational athletes and veterans, with age-group events available.

name: Viimsi maraton
description: Viimsi Marathon 2026 takes place on the Viimsi Peninsula and offers participants a course consisting of one large loop. The start and finish are in the parking lot of Randvere School. The varied terrain includes both paved roads and forest trails, with climbs and descents throughout the distance. It is a great opportunity to enjoy a summer run with a positive community.

name: Rapla Selveri suurjooks, virtuaaljooks
description: Rapla Selveri Suurjooks is a traditional running race held in Rapla, offering several distance options from children’s races to a half marathon. The race centre is located in the Rapla Selver car park, and the routes run along the town’s streets and highways. They are clearly marked and measured. Participants’ safety is ensured, and the event is organised by Kehakultuur OÜ in cooperation with Jooksja magazine. Pre-registration closes on 20 May, and start groups are formed according to expected finish times to ensure a smooth and safe race day.

name: Filter Temposari (3. etapp)
description: Filter Temposari is Estonia’s oldest and most prestigious time trial series, offering the chance to test yourself in cycling, running or inline skating. The events take place at various locations in Tallinn and the surrounding area, featuring speed races with individual starts. The Tallinn event is held at Vabaduse väljak, on a short, technical course well suited to sprint enthusiasts. Series finishers are eligible for the Kullapada awards programme, which rewards consistent participation in every event.

name: Kohila pikamaajooksude sari 2026 IV etapp 400m
description: The Kohila Long-Distance Running Series 2026, Stage IV (400 m), takes place at the Kohila Sports Centre stadium and is intended for all running enthusiasts. The series features various distances and age groups, with participants earning points according to their placing in each race. The entry fee is €8, or €5 for young people and pensioners; payment is in cash at the venue. Pre-registration is recommended and closes at 16:30 on race day. Those who register later will be placed in the later races. Series winners are determined by age group, and the awards ceremony takes place at the end of the series.

name: Kohila Pikamaajooksusari
description: The Kohila Distance Running Series is a sports series in Kohila Municipality consisting of several stages and aimed at sports enthusiasts in the region. The series aims to promote sports and physical activity and give participants the opportunity to compete over various distances. Participants at each stage receive a commemorative medal, and points are tallied across the series in the competition classes. The series is organized by Kohila Sports Centre, which supports a healthy lifestyle and active movement.

name: KEVEK ja Tartu Kalev staadionijooksu sari
description: The KEVEK and Tartu Kalev Stadium Running Series is an athletics track-running series organized by Tartu Spordiselts Kalev, offering the opportunity to take part in multiple meets at stadiums in Tartu and Ülenurme. The series aims to provide competition opportunities for children and young people and promote participation in athletics in the city and county of Tartu. Competitions take place during the summer months and are open to various age groups. Registration closes at 12:00 on the day of the competition, allowing for flexible participation.

name: Rakvere lahtised MV
description: The Rakvere Open Championships are athletics championships held at Rakvere Stadium. The competition brings together the local sporting community and offers an opportunity to watch a variety of track and field events. The event is open to everyone interested and creates a sporty, supportive atmosphere.

name: Tallinna noorte MV
description: The Tallinn Youth Championships is an individual athletics competition for young people and adults, held in Tallinn. The competition includes several age groups, from U-14 to adults, and a range of athletics events, including running, jumping, putting, and throwing. Its aim is to honour the memory of Eerik Konist and promote athletics among young people. Medals are awarded in all age groups, and the top performers receive special prizes. The competition takes place at a stadium and starts at 11:00 in the morning; registration opens at 10:00.

name: Kuusalu valla kergej. MV
description: The Kuusalu Parish Athletics Championships is a traditional athletics competition held in Kuusalu. The event features various age groups and distances, offering opportunities for both recreational and advanced athletes. It is dedicated to the memory of Margus Keerma and is organized by the Treeningpartner sports club. The competition is a great opportunity to showcase your skills and enjoy the sporting atmosphere in Kuusalu Parish.

name: Ümber Saadjärve jooks
description: The 38th Around Lake Saadjärv Run takes place on June 20, 2026, in Kukulinn, offering participants a 17 km run and a fitness walk around Lake Saadjärv. The course follows a paved road and has three water stations to keep participants well supplied during the event. In addition to the main run, children’s races are held in different age groups, along with a fitness walk suitable for everyone who enjoys being active. Every finisher receives a commemorative medal, and the top participants are awarded prizes by age group. This traditional, well-organized event offers an enjoyable sporting experience for the whole family.

name: Lääne-Virumaa jooksusari 2026 - 4. Pariisi Maastikujooks
description: The Lääne-Virumaa Running Series 2026 brings together fitness enthusiasts and recreational runners from spring to autumn, offering a variety of running and walking opportunities. The series aims to promote healthy lifestyles and encourage local people to take part in sporting events. The 4th Pariisi Cross-Country Run takes place on 21 June at Pariisi Holiday Village and is part of a long-running series featuring different age groups and distance options. Timing is chip-based, and race numbers must be attached to the stomach or chest, reflecting the organisers’ care for participants’ comfort and safety.

name: Mapri Ehitus x Vägilase jooks Rummu
description: Mapri Ehitus x Vägilase jooks Rummu is a varied obstacle race held at the Rummu quarry. On the course, participants climb, crawl, lift and drag their way through mud, water, sand and hills, making it a challenge for everyone. The race is part of the Vägilase jooks series, known as Estonia’s best OCR event. The course is more substantial and offers exciting obstacles and experiences in nature.

name: Maraton igas linnas Keila
description: Marathon in Every City Keila is a unique running event that gives participants the opportunity to run a marathon distance in different cities. There are refreshment stations every 400 metres along the course, as well as toilets, making the run more comfortable and supporting athletes’ well-being. The event is suitable both for experienced marathon runners and for those who want to test their endurance. It is well organised and offers an enjoyable experience for all participants.

name: Pärnumaa Võidupüha maraton
description: The Pärnumaa Victory Day Marathon takes place on 22 June 2026 in Tori Parish, with the race centre located by the historic Tori Estonian Soldiers’ Memorial Church. The marathon brings several new features and is organised in cooperation with the Pärnumaa Sports Association and its supporters. This traditional and legendary race offers athletes a varied and memorable experience.

name: Häädemeeste Võidupüha jooks
description: The Häädemeeste Victory Day Run is a traditional running event held near the Häädemeeste bus station. The event invites everyone who enjoys being active to celebrate Victory Day in a sporting and community-minded spirit. In addition to the main race, a children’s run for the youngest members of the family will be held for the first time. After the run, participants can enjoy the Midsummer celebration at Häädemeeste Summer Garden. Participation is free, and registration takes place on site.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Häädemeeste bus station
Children’s run before the main race
Midsummer celebration at Häädemeeste Summer Garden after the run
additional: Registration and gathering take place on site at the Häädemeeste bus station from 16:00 to 17:30. Participation is free.

name: 49. Jaanijooks ümber Karksi-Nuia paisjärve
description: The 49th Jaanijooks around the Karksi-Nuia Reservoir is a traditional running race held near the ruins of Karksi Order Castle. The race route circles the scenic Karksi-Nuia Reservoir, offering participants beautiful views and an enjoyable running experience. The event is intended for both recreational and experienced runners and offers a chance to enjoy an active day with the community.

name: Jooks suvesse
description: The Solstice Runs are an annual series of races consisting of several stages, where participants can earn points and compete in age groups. Jooks suvesse is one of the stages in the series and takes place in the Loode oak forest in Kuressaare. The course has varied terrain, including a cycle and pedestrian path and forest trails, which may be muddy depending on the weather. Participants are provided with electronic timing, reusable race bibs and drinking cups, and a sweet snack and drink at the finish.

name: 12. Rõuge maastikujooks-kõnd
description: The 12th Rõuge Trail Run and Walk is a trail running and Nordic walking event held in Rõuge Nightingale Valley, Võru County, offering participants the chance to enjoy nature and exercise. The event is suitable for runners, Nordic walkers and walkers who want to spend their time actively. The Centre of Excellence for Physical Activity organises the event to promote physical activity and a healthy lifestyle. Participants can experience beautiful scenery and the joy of exercise while enhancing their well-being.

name: Sillamäe promenaadijooks
description: Sillamäe Promenade Run is a well-known city race held near the Sillamäe Cultural Centre. The race began as a stair run and has been called the Promenade Run since 2021. The event offers various distances, from short races for little ones to the adults’ 7 km main distance, which also challenges trained athletes. It is a community-oriented and engaging event, with several activities in addition to running, and important contributions from supporters and volunteers.

name: EUTR - Estonia Ultra-Trail Race
description: The 9th edition of the Estonia Ultra-Trail Race (EUTR) will take place on 26–27 June 2026 in Narva, Ida-Virumaa County, Estonia. The race starts and finishes at the Akkekula (Nut Hill) sports complex. Organized by the non-profit sports club SK ETR, the event features trails certified by the International Trail Running Association (ITRA), with finishers eligible for ITRA points. The race offers several distances for trail runners of different levels, including an ultra-trail and shorter trail options.

name: Muraste jooks
description: The Muraste Run is part of the Harku Municipality running series and takes place on June 28, 2026, at Muraste School Stadium. The course runs along Muraste’s streets and shared-use paths, on marked roads open to traffic. A variety of distances are offered for both children and adults, as well as a family competition. Prizes are awarded to the top finishers in each age group, and participants who complete the series receive a season medal. The event is organized by MTÜ TreeningPluss, which promotes the joy of movement and an active lifestyle.

name: Märgatud laps jooksmas
description: The charity running series “Märgatud Laps jooksmas” takes place at the Kose song festival grounds and offers participants the chance to enjoy a sporting experience while supporting a good cause. The series aims to bring the community together and make the joy of exercise accessible to all age groups. The event is open to everyone interested in running and creates a friendly, supportive atmosphere.

name: Lääne-Virumaa jooksusari 2026 - 22. Emumäe jooks
description: The Lääne-Virumaa Running Series 2026 brings together recreational athletes and active people from spring to autumn, offering a chance to test their abilities in different age groups and distances. The 22nd Emumäe Run is the series’ fifth stage and takes place on 4 July at Emumäe. The series aims to popularise running and fitness walking and support local recreational athletes. Races are held over several distances, from short children’s races to main races of up to 10 km. Timing is chip-based, and race numbers must be attached to the stomach or chest.

name: Võhma terviseraja maraton
description: The Võhma health trail marathon is a trail marathon held on the health trail in the town of Võhma. The course is a 620-metre loop that must be completed 68 times, for a total of 42.2 km. The race takes place on 4 July 2026, starting at 9:00, and offers participants a medal, timekeeping, course support, refreshments at the finish, and washing facilities. In addition to the marathon, there is an opportunity to run a shorter distance for free and without timekeeping, suitable for everyone who enjoys being active.

name: J. Lossmanni mälestusjooks
description: The Jüri Lossmann Memorial Run is a traditional running competition held in Viljandi. The event takes place on 4 July 2026, starting at 19:00. The run is dedicated to Jüri Lossmann and offers participants the chance to enjoy a pleasant summer evening and a sporting challenge.

name: 6. Navi jooksu-kõnnitiir
description: The Võrumaa Running and Walking Series is a multi-stage series of running and walking events offering a range of distances for both adults and children. The main distances vary from approximately 5 to 8 kilometres, and the course runs mainly on asphalt and gravel roads, with a small section on soft terrain. The series also includes mini distances and runs for young children, suitable for all age groups. The events take place in various locations across Võrumaa, giving participants the opportunity to enjoy the region’s beautiful nature and sporting community.

name: Navi jooksutiir
description: Navi Run is a running, Nordic walking and walking event held in Võru County and organized by Navi Village Association. The event offers an opportunity to enjoy exercise and a healthy lifestyle in beautiful surroundings, and is suitable for participants of different abilities. Navi Run is part of a broader initiative to promote physical activity, with the aim of supporting an active and healthy lifestyle. Everyone who enjoys being active is invited to enjoy a sporty day and the joy of movement.

name: Kambja Tervisejooksud
description: Kambja Health Runs is a three-stage running series inviting both recreational and experienced runners to enjoy an active time outdoors. At each stage, participants can choose between a lap of the approximately 5 km health trail and a 10 km race. There is also an exciting power run to find the best ratio of strength to speed. Series finishers are eligible for prizes and prize draws, including a bicycle as the grand prize. Participation is free, and registration is available online and on-site.

name: 7. ETAPP
description: Käime Koos is a recreational sports series by the Estonian Sports Association Kalev, inviting participants to take part in various hiking and walking stages across Estonia. The 7th stage takes place on Kesselaid, offering participants the chance to enjoy the beautiful natural scenery of the Muhu escarpment. The series aims to promote physical activity and a healthy lifestyle through hiking and walking together. Participants can experience varied terrain and combine exercise with good company.
course_highlights: Beautiful natural scenery of the Muhu escarpment
Varied terrain suitable for walking and hiking
The series takes place in different parts of Estonia, showcasing local natural beauty
additional: Käime Koos stages take place in different locations across Estonia, where participants can enjoy nature and physical activity. The series is organised by the Estonian Sports Association Kalev. More information and contact: Sirje Soovik +372 506 2250.

name: 31. Joosu Järvejooksu sarja 4. etapp
location: Viljandi järve tervise- ja suusarada, Viljandi, Estonia
description: The 4th stage of the Joosu Lake Run Series is a running event around Lake Viljandi on the health and ski trail. The race is part of the traditional Joosu Series, offering participants the chance to enjoy beautiful nature and varied terrain. The course has good footing and is suitable for runners of different abilities. The event is organised by the Joosu Recreational Sports Club, which welcomes all running enthusiasts to take part.

name: Vooremäe tipujooks
description: Vooremäe Tipujooks is a running competition organized by the Tartumaa Sports Association and held at Vooremäe. It is a traditional summer sporting event that invites running enthusiasts to take part and offers the chance to enjoy beautiful scenery and competitive sport. The competition is part of the Tartumaa sports calendar and is suitable for runners of different ability levels.

name: 45. jooks ümber Pühajärve
location: Pühajärve Spa & Holiday Resort, Otepää, Valga County, Estonia
description: The 45th Run Around Lake Pühajärv is a traditional running race held around Pühajärv Spa & Holiday Resort. The distance is 10.7 km, and the course is well marked and secured, offering participants beautiful views of the lake. The race is part of the 2026 Maru Lake Runs series and is its third event. The start is at 12:00 on Saturday, July 11. Participants are provided with timing, refreshment stations and an awards ceremony.
course_highlights: A 10.7 km course around Lake Pühajärv
Refreshment stations at 4.4 km and 7.7 km
The course is marked and secured by course marshals
additional: Start groups are formed based on previous results; elite runners may start in the first group. Timing is chip-based, with the chip attached to the back of the race bib. Participants receive a medal, sports drink and water on the course and at the finish, as well as medical assistance along the entire course. The awards ceremony is scheduled for approximately 13:30, with awards for the top six. Participants can register on site, and discounts are available. The course runs around Lake Pühajärv and is suitable for both recreational and experienced runners.

name: Sportland Kõrvemaa Triatlon 2026
location: Kõrvemaa Matka- ja Suusakeskus, Kõrvemaa, Estonia
description: Sportland Kõrvemaa Triathlon takes place on 11 July 2026 at Kõrvemaa Hiking and Ski Centre and offers an exciting recreational triathlon experience. The main distance consists of a 250 m swim, a 20 km mountain-bike ride and a 4 km run, which runs largely along the ski trails and forest roads of the Põhja-Kõrvemaa Landscape Protection Area. In addition to the main event, participants can take part in the Stebby duathlon and youth duathlon, which are intended for different age groups. The event is well organised, with chip timing, medical support and aid stations. After the race, participants receive a medal and can enjoy hot soup, a sauna and bike washing facilities.
course_highlights: The swim takes place in the pond at Kõrvemaa Hiking and Ski Centre; one lap, with a maximum depth of 2.5 m
The 20 km cycling course follows the ski trails and forest roads of the Põhja-Kõrvemaa Landscape Protection Area
The 4 km trail run is marked and secured
additional: Starts are staggered in waves of five, with a 10-second interval between each start. Competitors must wear a helmet while cycling and a timing chip around their ankle. The entry fee includes medical first aid, aid-station service, a medal, hot soup, a smoothie, access to a sauna and hot tub, and bike washing. There is a bag drop at the event centre and a place to change clothes in the sauna anteroom. The swim number must be written on the cheek or shoulder with a waterproof marker. Drafting is allowed during the cycling leg. Trail course, family races, free soup and sauna, registration information, entry fees vary, limited number of places

name: Mõisa jooks
organizer: SK Team Kehtna ja Alutaguse vallavalitsus
description: Kehtna Manor Run is a friendly, community-focused running event held in the grounds of Kehtna Manor. It offers three distances: a 5 km main race, a 2.5 km youth race, and a 500 m children’s race, welcoming participants of different ages. Alongside the races, the event features Children’s Day activities, pony rides, and trampolines, creating a pleasant family-day atmosphere. It is organized by SK Team Kehtna, which is dedicated to promoting sport and physical activity in the community.

name: 5. Pühajärve pargimiil
description: The 5th Pühajärve Park Mile is a 1.6 km running race held in the park of Pühajärve Holiday Resort on Saturday, July 11, 2026. The start and finish are at the same location, and the race begins at 12:10. The race is open to all running enthusiasts and offers a pleasant opportunity to enjoy a run in a beautiful park setting. Participants are provided with a medal, a race bib, chip timing, sports drink and water at the finish, and medical assistance along the entire course.

name: Pajusi Mudajooks
organizer: MTÜ Sporty ja MTÜ Pajusi Küla Selts
description: Pajusi Mudajooks is a popular mass-participation sporting event in Central Estonia, offering participants an exciting and adventurous obstacle course on a route of up to 10 km. The event takes place on July 11, 2026, in Pajusi village and is suitable for both individual runners and teams. The course features natural and man-made obstacles that challenge participants’ physical and mental endurance. Separate courses are available for children, and all finishers receive a medal as a keepsake. Free parking and hot soup after the run are provided for participants.

name: PALMS Südasuve Challenge - Võsu 2026
location: Võsu, Lääne-Nigula vald, Lääne County, Estonia
description: PALMS Midsummer Challenge - Võsu 2026 is a sporting summer event held in the town of Võsu. It is an enjoyable and active challenge for running enthusiasts, offering the chance to enjoy summer nature and community support. The event is part of the Estonian Night Run series and brings together runners from different regions. Võsu’s beautiful coastal scenery provides excellent conditions for a sporting experience.
course_highlights: Coastal scenery in the town of Võsu
A pleasant, active summer running environment
Part of the Estonian Night Run series
additional: The event includes a range of swimming distances and is open to both local and virtual participants, offering summer sea air and sport in a friendly atmosphere.

name: Vimka tõusu maraton
description: Vimka Tõusu Marathon is a summer marathon on the Viimsi Peninsula, offering participants one large loop. The start and finish are in the parking lot of Randvere School. The varied course includes both paved roads and forest trails, with several climbs and descents that make the run exciting and varied.

name: Võru kergejõustikuõhtu
description: The Võru Athletics Evenings series is a traditional series of track and field events combining throwing, jumping, and running disciplines. The series consists of several stages, where participants can compete in different distances and events, with the IAAF scoring tables used to determine the rankings. The competitions take place at Võru Stadium and are open to athletes of varying abilities. The series offers a varied track and field experience for both recreational and advanced athletes.

name: Lüllemäe mägedejooks
description: Lüllemäe Mountain Run is the third event in the Valgamaa running series and takes place on the Lüllemäe health trails. The main race distance is 4.5 km, and children’s toddler and mini runs are also held at the Lüllemäe Basic School stadium. The event is suitable for runners of different ages and offers a chance to enjoy beautiful nature and a sporting competitive atmosphere. Children’s runs are free, and the main race entry fees are reasonable, encouraging broad participation.

name: Lääne-Virumaa jooksusari 2026 - 9. Rakvere valla Suvejooks
description: Lääne-Virumaa Running Series 2026 is a multi-stage running and walking series featuring various running competitions in the Lääne-Virumaa region. Stage 9, Rakvere Municipality Summer Run, takes place on 18 July 2026 at Kooli 4 in Rakvere. The series aims to offer a sporting challenge and enjoyment to running enthusiasts and support an active lifestyle throughout the region.

name: Väinjärve jooks , 8. Järvamaa Järvede jooksud VI etapp
description: The Järvamaa Lakes Runs is a traditional running series made up of several stages around different lakes in Järvamaa. The Väinjärve Run, taking place on 18 July 2026, is the series’ sixth stage. The race gives participants the opportunity to enjoy the beautiful natural surroundings and varied terrain around the lake. The series offers several distances and is suitable for both recreational and experienced runners.

name: 31. Jooks-kõnd ümber Uhtjärve
description: The 31st Run-Walk Around Lake Uhtjärv is a traditional running and walking series in the Võru region, offering a range of distances for every participant. The event takes place in the beautiful natural surroundings of Lake Uhtjärv, providing a sporting challenge for both runners and walkers. The series includes various distances and mini-distances suitable for beginners and experienced athletes alike. The event is part of the Võru County running and walking series, known for its friendly atmosphere and good organization.

name: Jooks ümber Uhtjärve
description: The Võrumaa Running and Walking Series is a multi-stage series of running and walking events, offering a range of distances for both adults and children. The main distances range from approximately 5 to 8 kilometres, and the course runs mainly on asphalt and gravel roads, with some off-road sections. The series also includes mini-distances and runs for toddlers, suitable for all age groups. The event is open to everyone interested in sport and promotes healthy lifestyles and community involvement.

name: Aastajooks
organizer: Spordiklubi Pärnu Kahe Silla Klubi MTÜ
description: The Pärnu Annual Runs are a traditional running series that began in 1985 and are inspired by the Eastern calendar, dedicating each year to its corresponding symbolic animal. The 2026 series is themed around the Year of the Fire Horse and consists of nine stages held in three different areas of Pärnu: Vallikäär, Pärnu Beach, and the Reiu-Raeküla health trail. Three stages take place at each location, offering participants a varied and enjoyable running experience. The series aims to provide a sporting challenge and enjoyment for both recreational and experienced runners.

name: Kohila Pikamaajooksusari
description: The Kohila Long-Distance Running Series is a competition for sports enthusiasts in Kohila Parish, offering a variety of running opportunities for different age and ability groups. The series aims to promote recreational exercise and provide participants with an enjoyable sporting experience. Participants receive a beautiful commemorative medal at each stage, and the series standings are based on points. The series is organized by Kohila Sports Centre, which provides modern facilities and a strong sporting environment.

name: KEVEK ja Tartu Kalev staadionijooksu sari
description: The KEVEK and Tartu Kalev Stadium Running Series is a running series competition organised by Tartu Spordiselts Kalev and held in the city of Tartu. The series has several stages, offering opportunities to take part in track races across different age groups. Competitions are held mainly at Tamme and Ülenurme Stadiums and are aimed at both young people and adults, providing a sporty and friendly competition environment. Registration closes at 12:00 on race day, offering flexibility for participants.

name: Mispo maastikumaraton
description: Mispo Trail Marathon is a trail race held in the Kurgja area of North Pärnumaa. The race distances are 42.195 km (marathon), 21.097 km (half marathon), 14 km and 7 km. The start is at the C. R. Jakobson Farm Museum at 11:00, and the race office opens at 9:00. All finishers receive a drink, food, access to the sauna, a diploma and a medal at the finish. The traditional event is organised by Terviseklubi Mispo, an active sports club since 1989.

name: Sakala metsajooks
description: The Sakala Forest Run is a trail race held in the Metsarada area in Kurgja municipality. The event offers several distances, including a marathon, half marathon, and shorter 7 km and 14 km runs. The race starts at 11:00 from the C. R. Jakobson Farm Museum, and participants are provided with a drink, food, sauna, certificate, and medal at the finish. The traditional event is organised by the Mispo Health Club and offers a sporty, friendly atmosphere.

name: KFC Südasuve Challenge - Pirita 2026
description: KFC Midsummer Challenge is a midsummer sports celebration taking place in Pirita for the third time. This community run offers beautiful views of the sea and the Old Town, with three distances to choose from. Participants can run, walk, or cover the distance with a stroller or walking poles. The start and finish are conveniently located in the same place on the beachfront, and the route follows a seaside pedestrian and cycling path without closing roads to traffic. All finishers will receive KFC gifts, and an event host and mascot will keep the spirits high.

name: Leigo Trail
description: Leigo Trail is a varied trail run in Southern Estonia, held around the Leigo Lakes. The race centre is at Leigo Tourism Farm, and the event offers a choice of distances and difficulty levels, making it suitable for both beginners and experienced runners. The routes follow forest trails, clay and gravel roads, and natural paths along the lakeshore, with technical climbs and descents and beautiful views. The event brings together nature, exercise, and community, offering an enjoyable experience for the whole family.

name: Iigaste metsajooks
description: The Iigaste Forest Run is part of the Rein Leppik Valgamaa running and Nordic walking series, held every summer. This forest run gives participants the chance to enjoy beautiful nature and a sporting challenge on the 7.4 km main course, as well as shorter running and Nordic walking distances. The event takes place in Iigaste village and is suitable for different age groups, with medals and diplomas awarded to the top finishers. Entry is affordable, and registration is conveniently available online.

name: 10. ETAPP
description: TV 10 Olümpiastarti is a competition series organized by the Estonian Athletic Association for schoolchildren and young athletes. Competitions take place in various age groups and include a range of athletics events. The 10th stage takes place on July 29, 2026, at Tamme Stadium in Tartu, giving young athletes the opportunity to test their skills and gain experience. The series aims to support young people’s athletic development and provide a fun, motivating competition environment.

name: Vormsi maraton
description: Vormsi Marathons VIII is a two-day running event on Vormsi Island, taking place on July 31 and August 1 near Sviby Harbour. Participants can choose the marathon or half-marathon distance on both days, with the courses running mainly on paved roads on Vormsi Island. The courses are marked, and timing is provided using electronic SI sticks. After the run, participants can join a social gathering and enjoy a sauna and hot soup at the finish. The event is small and friendly, suitable for both experienced runners and recreational runners.

name: 28. Holstre-Paistu maanteejooks Hanno Priksi mälestuseks
description: Holstre-Paistu Road Race is the fourth stage of Viljandi Municipality’s running series and takes place in Paistu. The race is intended for runners of all abilities and offers young people and adults alike the opportunity to take part. Participation in the series motivates runners to complete all four stages, and active participants are rewarded. The course runs through the scenic Viljandi County, offering an enjoyable running experience.
course_highlights: Road race in the Paistu area
Participation opportunities in different age groups
Participants are motivated by awards in the running series

name: Mapri Ehitus x Öövägilane
description: Mapri Ehitus x Öövägilane is an obstacle course race held on the Lähte health trails. It is a varied and challenging run where participants climb, crawl, lift and are dragged through mud, water, sand and over hills. The event is suitable for both beginners and experienced obstacle racers, offering an exciting and fun experience. The series aims to offer a multi-day competition where each stage has its own character, with an emphasis on both fun and physical challenge.

name: Mapri Ehitus x Vägilase jooks Lähte
description: Mapri Ehitus x Vägilase jooks Lähte is an obstacle race held on the Lähte health trails and at the outdoor gym. The courses are 4 km and 8 km long and offer participants a serious challenge, with a variety of obstacles testing both strength and agility. Vägilase jooks is Estonia’s most versatile obstacle race series event, suitable for both beginners and experienced obstacle racers. The event is part of a series focused on terrain, obstacles and an adventurous experience.

name: Vääna-Jõesuu jooks
description: The Vääna-Jõesuu Run is part of the Harku Municipality Running Series and takes place on August 2, 2026, at the Vääna-Jõesuu School stadium. The event offers several distances, from children’s races to the 5 km main race, which runs counterclockwise along the streets of Vääna-Jõesuu and a forest road. The series aims to motivate people to take part in sports and to promote the joy of exercise and an active lifestyle. The event is organized by local running and triathlon clubs in cooperation with the municipality and village associations.

name: ÜLEMISTE Ööjooks - Tallinn 2026
description: ÜLEMISTE Night Run - Tallinn 2026 is a running and walking event taking place in the Ülemiste district of Tallinn. The event offers an opportunity to get active and support well-being and health. It is part of a wider initiative to promote recreational physical activity in Estonia, organised by the Centre of Competence for Recreational Physical Activity. Participants can enjoy being active in an urban environment and support their mental and physical health.
course_highlights: Running and walking in the Ülemiste district of Tallinn
A great opportunity to get active and support your health
Organised by the Centre of Competence for Recreational Physical Activity
additional: Participation involves running and walking; registration is open

name: Lääne-Virumaa jooksusari 2026 - 20. Tapa linnajooks
description: The Lääne-Viru County Running Series is a traditional running and walking series offering a variety of running opportunities for different age groups and ability levels. The events take place in different locations across Lääne-Viru County, giving runners the chance to enjoy both urban and trail running. The 20th Tapa City Run takes place on August 8, 2026, near Tapa Gymnasium and is part of the series’ long-standing tradition of bringing together recreational athletes and running enthusiasts. The series aims to motivate people to stay active and provide enjoyable running experiences.

name: Paldiski liigub
description: Paldiski Moves is the third stage of the West-Harju Movement Series, held at Paldiski Sports Centre. The course passes Paldiski’s main attractions, streets and shared-use paths, offering participants beautiful natural views and a historic atmosphere. Free children’s races are organised for the younger members of the family, with an emphasis on the joy of movement and lifelong physical activity. The event takes place as part of Paldiski City Day, when the series’ top performers are awarded, and the evening ends with a concert.

name: Kohila pikamaajooksude sari 2026 VI etapp 1000m
description: The Kohila Long-Distance Running Series 2026, Stage VI (1000 m), takes place at the Kohila Sports Centre stadium and is open to everyone interested in running. The series includes different distances and age groups, with participants earning points and winners determined by age group. The entry fee is €8, or €5 for young people and pensioners. Registration is primarily available in advance, and on-site registration is possible until 18:30. The series winners will be awarded after the final race. To place among the prize winners, participants must take part in at least four stages.

name: Filter Temposari (5. etapp)
description: Filter Temposari is Estonia’s oldest and most prestigious time-trial series, offering the chance to test yourself in cycling, running or roller skating. The stages take place at various locations in Tallinn and the surrounding area, featuring individual-start speed races. The races are short and intense, suitable for both recreational and advanced participants. The series also includes the Kullapada prize programme, which rewards consistent participation in every stage over the same distance.

name: 14. ETAPP / Järve terviserada
description: 14th STAGE / The Järve health trail is a 10-stage relay race around Lake Viljandi, held on varied terrain and a health trail with different surface types. Teams consist of 10 members, with an equal number of women and men, who take turns running the different stages. The start and finish are at Viljandi City Stadium, and runners are taken to the stages on buses provided by the organizers. The race is part of the tradition of the Suurjooks ümber Viljandi järve and offers a sporting experience for schools, companies, and sports clubs.

name: 31. Joosu Järvejooksu sarja 5. etapp
location: Viljandi Lake Health and Ski Trail, Viljandi, Estonia
description: The 5th stage of the Joosu Lake Run series is a running race organized by the Joosu sports club. It takes place on the health and ski trail around Lake Viljandi. The race gives participants the opportunity to enjoy beautiful lake views and varied terrain. It is a great opportunity for both recreational and experienced runners to take part in a friendly and supportive environment.

Beautiful lake views along the route
Varied terrain suitable for runners

name: Lääne-Virumaa jooksusari 2026 - 27. Viru-Nigula Rahvajooks
description: The Lääne-Virumaa Running Series 2026 offers a varied series of running and walking events, bringing together fitness enthusiasts and recreational athletes from spring to autumn. The 27th Viru-Nigula People’s Run takes place on the Viru-Nigula running track and in the long-jump pit. It is part of a long-running series that encourages participation across different age groups and distances. The series aims to promote healthy lifestyles and offer participants the chance to test their abilities. The events are well organized, with chip timing, ensuring participants an enjoyable and motivating running experience.

name: 15. ETAPP / Vabaõhumuuseum
description: The Health Run and Walk is a multi-stage running and walking event held in various parts of Tallinn, including the Estonian Open Air Museum. Each stage offers a chance to enjoy beautiful nature trails and the benefits of recreational sport. The Estonian Open Air Museum stage is 4.2 km long and is well suited to both runners and walkers who want to spend active time outdoors. The event is a tradition and is open to everyone interested in recreational sport.

name: 10. Üts Ummamuudu liina üüjuusk-kõnd
description: The 10th Üts Ummamuudu City Night Run-Walk is a physical activity event in Võru, featuring running, Nordic walking, and walking. The event is part of the activities of the Physical Activity Competence Centre, which aims to promote an active lifestyle and health. Everyone is welcome to take part, improve their wellbeing, and enjoy being active at every stage of life. The beautiful nature of Võru County provides a pleasant setting for physical activity.

name: Lüganuse rahvajooks
description: Lüganuse Public Run is part of the Ida-Viru Running Series and takes place in Kiviõli Central Square. The event offers several distances, from a children’s race to a 9 km run, suitable for different age groups and skill levels. Participants can enjoy a friendly, community-focused atmosphere and compete in the team category. Registration is easy and the entry fee is affordable, making this a great event for both recreational and experienced runners.

name: 22. Ülemiste metsajooks
description: The 22nd Ülemiste Forest Run is an environmentally friendly 3 km trail run held around the Tallinn Water Treatment Plant. The race centre, start and finish are located at Järvevana tee 3. The run takes place on Saturday, 29 August 2026, starting at 11:50. Participants are provided with a marked route, sports drink and water at the finish, and medical assistance along the entire course. The event is open to all running enthusiasts and offers an enjoyable, active experience.

name: Sillamäe ultra 2026: Eesti meistrivõistlused 100 km jooksus
description: Sillamäe Ultra 2026 is the Estonian 100 km running championship, taking place on the Sillamäe health trail and at outdoor gyms on August 29, 2026. It is a traditional ultrarun in which participants cover a road-running distance while competing for the Estonian championship title. The race offers a challenge for both local and international ultrarunners who appreciate the course’s variety and the event’s organization. Sillamäe Ultra is known for its organization and strong participant community.

name: Tallinna Vee 54. jooks ümber Ülemiste järve
description: The 54th Tallinna Vesi Run Around Lake Ülemiste is a traditional running race taking place on 29 August 2026. The Run Around Lake Ülemiste is part of the Maru Lake Runs series, and this year’s race is the series’ final, fourth event. The marked course is 13.7 km long and starts and finishes at the Tallinn Water Treatment Plant at Järvevana tee 3. The event centre opens early in the morning, and race materials are distributed on site. Participants are provided with chip timing; the chip is attached to the back of the race bib.

name: 9. Kristiine Rahvajooks
description: The 9th Kristiine Community Run takes place on August 30, 2026, at the playground in Löwenruh Park in Tallinn. description:

name: SPORTLAND KÕRVEMAA METSAJOOKS  27. SEPTEMBER 2026
description:
Why take part in the Kõrvemaa Forest Run?

- Probably the most beautiful trails, surrounded by unspoilt nature.
- 100% of the course is in a stunning nature reserve.
- Give your body and mind a boost.
- Bring the whole family: activities and childcare are organised for the little ones, too.
- A convenient, compact event centre close to Tallinn.
- Free soup, a smoothie and other surprises from our partners for everyone.
- Of course, there’ll also be a hot sauna and, for the bolder participants, a hot tub.
- You can also take part with your whole work team to boost team spirit and health.
- Together, we’re helping improve public health in Estonia.

The Sportland pop-up shop will be open all day, so you can top up your running gear if you’ve forgotten something at home or want the best functional gear for the course. Every finisher will receive a great medal, a GRAM drink and a Nicks bar. Winners will receive Sportland credit, a sapling and gifts from our partners. The season’s best in each age group and the season’s best team will also be recognised.

Want to enjoy a private sauna with your group? Rent the Iglusaun by the pond! Would you like to stay overnight in Kõrvemaa? Check availability at Kuuse Elamusmajad.
course_highlights: 100% of the course runs through a stunning nature reserve
Trail running in unspoilt nature, with a mix of climbs and descents
Routes suitable for beginners and experienced runners alike
additional:
Register online at iseteenindus.sportlandkorvemaa.ee or through the Sportos platform, where Stebby is also available as a payment method.

The event takes place on Sunday, 27.09.2026. On race day, you can register at the start venue from 10.00. Registration closes 30 minutes before the start.

Seniors (aged 60+) and young people (aged up to 17) receive a 50% discount on the main distances when registering in advance. The discount is applied automatically during registration based on year of birth. The minimum discounted price is 15 EUR; the discount will not reduce the price below this amount. The discount does not apply to youth races, which already have a special price of 15 EUR. Only one discount can be used at a time; the system always applies the larger discount.

A 10% discount applies when registering at least 5 people together. A 20% discount applies when registering at least 10 people together. If you are registering from the same company, club or group of friends, be sure to enter your team name, as we will award the best team to take part in the series at the end of the season.

name: Swedbanki Tallinna Maraton
description:
Swedbank Tallinn Marathon and Tallinn Autumn Run invite you to register!

Estonia’s largest running and movement festival, the Swedbank Tallinn Marathon, takes place from September 11 to 13. The programme of this event, which brings together thousands of active people, includes the classic marathon (42.195 km) and marathon relay, half marathon (21.1 km), Tallinn Autumn Run (10 km), Nike Youth Run (5 km), Welcome Run and Limpa Kids’ Runs.

The Tallinn Marathon’s event centre and start-finish area are located on the edge of Tallinn’s Old Town, a UNESCO World Heritage Site. The course runs along streets and cycle and pedestrian paths, passing interesting places and offering a colourful overview of Estonia’s capital.

Over the years, more than 340,000 active people have taken part in the Tallinn Marathon across its various distances. The record for international participants at Estonia’s largest sporting event by number of participants was set in 2025, when runners came from as many as 93 countries.

Take this opportunity to be part of Estonia’s most spectacular movement event!
